headline: Indian Stock Markets Extend Weekly Gains Driven by FII Inflows and AI Rotation Trade

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investor (FII) fund inflows continue to boost market sentiment.
Global AI retreat has triggered a rotation trade back into Indian equities.
Lower crude oil prices provide support to Indian stock markets.
Investors are closely tracking upcoming WPI inflation data and global oil price trends.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty extended their gains for the third consecutive week.
PSU bank stocks surged 7.5% while smallcap indices jumped 3.6%.
Inflation concerns briefly weighed on market sentiment causing minor pullbacks.
Government and private health insurance spending crossed 20% of total health expenditure.
summary: Indian stock markets extended gains for a third straight week, buoyed by foreign fund inflows and easing crude oil prices. A global rotation away from AI stocks has helped fuel renewed interest in Indian equities. Market participants are watching WPI inflation figures and FII trends to guide trading direction this week.
